meta.data_description_zh:
提供1979年至最新發表年度癌症個案歸戶後之年報資料，包含各癌症原位癌及侵
襲癌個案。其資料的整理包含所有長表及短表醫院申報資料，且已去除同一個案同
一癌症別，且同一組織型態組別之重複個案。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 原位癌或侵襲癌個案之辨識，請以組織型態性態碼(HISTBEH欄位第 5碼)區
分。
2. 有關死亡原因及死亡日期欄位，為醫院申報當時之資料，若後續個案死亡，並
不會再做更新，故不提供此欄位資料以免誤解。若有需要，請直接連結死因統
計檔(Health-10)。
3. 癌症部分(CASITE欄位)，已新增為5碼，若第1碼為”H”者，表示為血液腫瘤
個案。若要再細分NHL(非何杰金氏淋巴瘤)、HL(何杰金氏淋巴瘤)及LEU(白血
病)等血液腫瘤個案，必須以組織病理(HISTBEH欄位)作區分。若是要分析各癌
症部分(CASITE欄位)，請先把NHL、HL、LEU等血液腫瘤排除後再計算。
4. 2002年起診斷之新發癌症個案，始收錄分級分化程度(GRADE 欄位)資料。另自
2018年起新增編碼A/B/C/D/E/H/L/M/S/X(詳見107年版癌症登記摘錄手冊短表
45欄位與長表115欄位內容)
5. 治療情形(TX欄位)已合併個案所有申報醫院治療狀況。2007年以後收錄之詳細
治療資料，請另見長、短表治療欄位。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
meta.primary_keys_raw:
1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。
meta.data_description_en: Provides annual reports from 1979 to the latest published year for cancer cases after householding, including in situ and invasive cases of all cancers. The data includes both long-form and short-form hospital claims and has removed duplicate cases within the same case for the same type of cancer and tissue type group.
meta.notes_en:
1. Carcinoma in situ and invasive cancer cases should be distinguished
by the 5th digit of the histology behavior code (HISTBEH field).
2. The cause of death and date of death fields reflect the data at the time
of hospital reporting and are not updated if the case later dies, so these fields
are not provided to avoid misunderstanding. If needed, link directly to the cause-of-death statistics file (Health-10).
3. The cancer site (CASITE field) has been expanded to 5 characters; if the first
character is "H", the case is a hematologic malignancy. To further subdivide hematologic malignancy cases
into NHL (non-Hodgkin lymphoma), HL (Hodgkin lymphoma) and LEU (leukemia), use histopathology (HISTBEH field). To analyze
by cancer site (CASITE field), first exclude hematologic malignancies such as NHL, HL and LEU.
4. Grade/differentiation (GRADE field) is collected only for new cancer cases diagnosed from
2002. Codes A/B/C/D/E/H/L/M/S/X were added from 2018 (see the ROC year 107 (2018) edition
Cancer Registry Abstracting Manual, short form field 45 and long form field 115).
5. Treatment status (TX field) combines the treatment status from all reporting hospitals for the case. For
detailed treatment data collected from 2007 onward, see the treatment fields of the long and short forms.
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address were deleted, and fields such as
national ID number, facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of visit and admission date are
masked. The data may be used only in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results that
pass review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
meta.primary_keys_en:
1. Personal ID number (ID) is encrypted.
2. Key for individual linkage and personal-data matching: ID.

meta.notes_en:
1. This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address were deleted,
and fields such as national ID number, facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of
birth, date of visit and admission date are masked. The data may be used only in the
independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results that pass review may be

5. Histopathology (HISTOLOG field) value 99903 applies only to codes used up to and

6. Grade/differentiation (GRADE field) is collected only for new cancer cases diagnosed from
